claim_assessments.claim: `cls12` readout encodes MW as continuous property.
claim_assessments.reason: AUROC threshold-vs-continuous (0.993) is near-perfect, indicating the model's internal scalar tracks magnitude well enough to recover binary violations.

claim_assessments.claim: HBD/HBA driven by trivial atom counts.
claim_assessments.reason: Random and Bag-of-tokens achieve AUROC ~1.0, matching Pretrained performance within noise margins (e.g., MW 0.988 vs Bot 0.999). No structural signal required.
Cosine similarities (MW: 0.803, HBA: 0.773) are significantly higher than LogP/HBD (~0.3-0.5), confirming geometric alignment.
Bag-of-tokens AUROC (MW: 0.999) matches Pretrained `cls12` (MW: 0.988). Gap is negligible compared to task triviality.
